protocol.timer: Before focus, one animation frame after focus inside the timer, fill commits the full phrase, exact final input assertion, then expected visible result
protocol.warmUpdateTimer: Before focus and fill until expected result is visible after complete search payload download
protocol.completionMetric: Full download uses all advertised ResourceTiming responseEnd values on both sides. Progressive UI completed status is a candidate-only diagnostic, never an equivalent baseline readiness measure.
protocol.cancellationPolicy: Only canceled ERR_ABORTED Fetch requests with explicit Next RSC prefetch headers or paired same-route RSC prefetch evidence are diagnostics. Active search, scripts, styles, HTTP failures and console errors remain failures.
protocol.transferMetric: CDP Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength includes encoded body and transport overhead. Body bytes at hit use CDP Network.dataReceived. Server logs record exact encoded body lengths.
limitations: Fill commits a complete Chinese phrase. It does not reproduce keyboard IME composition or per-character input latency. Physical IME behavior is unverified.
Immediate synthetic sequential Chinese input lost its first character under CPU4x in diagnostic runs. Such runs are rejected, not repaired or accepted.
Synthetic Chinese prose reuses repository paragraphs and may compress better than independent posts.
Local in-process server uses HTTP/1.1 and gzip. CDN, HTTP/2, Brotli, DNS and TLS are not simulated.
No automatic speedup verdict. A separate untimed profile must identify the limiter before interpreting a measured difference.
Mobile viewport and CPU/network throttling are desktop Chromium emulation, not a physical phone.
